main_body: Snow-covered building: a large sloped roof (rows 8-50) over a timber front wall with an arched double door and two windows (rows 52-76)
top_band: Light snow roof slope, rows 8-50 (L 249/228/200 with 166/130 clump shading). Its bottom row 48-50 is a lighter eave edge, then the wall begins at row 52.
evidence: The roof is a big foreshortened slope seen from above, and the timber wall sits under it as a separate vertical face. The roof reads like the reference tile roofs. A bright snow eave lip ends the roof, and a shadowed row with icicles lies just under it. The door has dark iron bands and a dark inner edge, and the windows have sills and snow caps, so they read as inset. No receding side face is drawn.

style.evidence: The snow roof has 5 lightness steps in scalloped clumps, with moss patches, icicles and a snow-covered base. The wall has plank grain in several browns plus lit windows. Dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outlines carry a navy/brown tint. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. Colours per tile (9) and distinct colours (42) are below the references (11-18 and 66-185), so density is slightly lower, but the snow palette is naturally narrow and the structure and texture hold up next to the references.
